items.title: Did The Market Read Marvell Stock Right?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock fell 7.3% on Monday, September 14. A $10,000 holding at the prior close was worth about $9,270 when trading ended that day. That fall is hard to explain from the company alone. Less than three weeks earlier, management had raised its revenue forecast for fiscal 2028. Did the market read Marvell stock right that Monday.

items.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Starts Custom AI Chip Shipments And Eyes Higher Forecasts
items.summary: Marvell Technology (NasdaqGS:MRVL) plans to lift its AI revenue outlook after deepening its custom silicon partnership with Alphabet's Google. The firm has begun shipping custom Compute Express Link chips to Google as part of its newest AI hardware programs. Management expects large-scale custom AI inference silicon programs with Google to ramp through 2028, pointing to a multi-year engagement. items.title: This AI Infrastructure Stock Is Flying Under the Radar
items.summary: Marvell has already tripled this year while most investors are still focused elsewhere, and the company just locked in a deal with Google that could reshape its entire revenue mix. The question is whether the stock's sky-high multiple leaves room for another leg up or sets the stage for a painful correction.
